title: 16 Woodlands Road, Glenageary, Co. Dublin
description:
Beautiful Fully Furnished 1-Bedroom Mews with Private Patio/Garden – Granitefield, Rochestown Avenue

A beautifully finished, fully furnished one-bedroom mews in the highly convenient Granitefield area, just off Rochestown Avenue.

This bright and modern property features impressive 10-foot-high ceilings, creating a wonderful feeling of space and light throughout.

The mews is super-insulated, providing excellent warmth, comfort and energy efficiency throughout the year. It also has its own private patio/garden, offering valuable outdoor space for relaxing and outdoor dining.

The property comes fully furnished and ready to move into.

PROPERTY FEATURES

• Spacious double bedroom
• Modern bathroom
• Bright open-plan living and dining area
• Fully fitted modern kitchen
• Fully furnished throughout
• 10-foot-high ceilings
• Private patio/garden
• Super-insulated construction
• Excellent natural light
• Modern fixtures and fittings
• Warm and energy-efficient
• Private mews-style property
• Quiet, mature residential setting

EXCELLENT LOCATION

Granitefield is superbly located just off Rochestown Avenue, with convenient access to Cabinteely, Killiney, Dalkey, Dún Laoghaire, Deansgrange, Blackrock, Cherrywood, Carrickmines and Sandyford.

Everyday shopping and amenities are close by, including Killiney Shopping Centre and SuperValu, together with a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants and services in the surrounding area.

For recreation and outdoor activities, the property is conveniently located for Cabinteely Park, Kilbogget Park, Killiney Hill and the South Dublin coastline. Dalkey, Killiney and Dún Laoghaire are also within easy reach.

EXCELLENT TRANSPORT LINKS

The area is very well served by public transport, with numerous bus services operating along and around Rochestown Avenue, providing connections throughout South Dublin and towards Dublin City Centre.

DART and Luas connections are also accessible from the surrounding area.

For motorists, Rochestown Avenue provides convenient access to the N11 and M50, with Cherrywood, Sandyford and Carrickmines all easily accessible.

With its 10-foot ceilings, full furnishings, excellent insulation and private patio/garden, this is a bright, comfortable and exceptionally well-located home in South Dublin.

Viewing highly recommended.
